Shared error envelope: `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string } }`
Pagination: `limit` default 20 max 100; `offset` default 0; page `{ items, total, limit, offset }`.

**Story:** A user enters their email to receive a one-time code and start signing in or registering.

POST /auth/otp/request — public. Sends a one-time code and reports whether the client must collect lane.

**Auth:** none

**Request body (JSON):**
- `email` (required, string) — Inbox that receives the OTP; normalized server-side. Example: `"member@example.com"`.

**Success `202`:**
- `status` (enum) — Delivery accepted. Value: `OTP_SENT`.
- `isNewUser` (boolean) — `true` = no live app account yet — collect `lane` (+ optional `name`) before Verify; `false` = returning user — omit `lane` on Verify.

**Errors:** `422` VALIDATION_ERROR / EMAIL_ADDRESS_INVALID · `429` AUTH_RATE_LIMITED · `502` OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED

After success, paste the emailed OTP into `otpToken`, then run Verify OTP.

request.description:
**Story:** A user submits the email code to finish sign-in; first-time users are provisioned as Client or Staff.

POST /auth/otp/verify — public. Sign-in = provision on first success.

**Auth:** none

**Request body (JSON):**
- `email` (required, string) — Same email used in Request OTP. Example: `"member@example.com"`.
- `token` (required, string) — Digits only (noise stripped); length 6–10 (project OTP is currently **6**). Example: `"123456"`.
- `lane` (first provision only, enum) — Account lane; omit on returning sign-in. Values: `CLIENT`, `STAFF`.
- `name` (optional, string) — Display name, 1–120 chars after trim. Example: `"Member"`.

**Success `200`:** `{ session, user }`

**`session` fields:**
- `accessToken` (string) — Bearer token (JWT).
- `refreshToken` (string) — Rotating refresh token.
- `expiresIn` (number) — Access TTL in seconds. Example: `3600`.

**`user` fields:**
- `id` (uuid) — App user id. Example: `"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"`.
- `email` (string) — Normalized email. Example: `"member@example.com"`.
- `name` (string) — Display name. Example: `"Member"`.
- `lane` (enum) — Immutable after provision. Values: `CLIENT`, `STAFF`.
- `roleCode` (enum) — Effective role. Values: `CLIENT`, `STAFF_UNASSIGNED`, `TRAINER`, `ADMIN`.
- `staffCode` (string or null) — Staff code; null for CLIENT. Example: `"STAFF-AB12"` or `null`.
- `emailVerifiedAt` (string ISO or null) — Verified at. Example: `"2026-08-02T00:00:00.000Z"`.

STAFF first login: `roleCode` = `STAFF_UNASSIGNED`, `staffCode` non-null.

**Errors:** `422` OTP_EXPIRED / VALIDATION_ERROR / EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED / LANE_REQUIRED · `409` LANE_MISMATCH

originalRequest.description:
POST /auth/otp/verify — public. Verifies OTP and provisions the app user on first success.

**Request body (JSON):**
- `email` string (required)
- `token` string digits, 6–10 (required) — use `{{otpToken}}`
- `lane` enum `CLIENT` | `STAFF` (required on **first** provision; omit when Request OTP returned `isNewUser: false`)
- `name` string 1–120 (optional)

**Response type:** `application/json`
**Success:** `200`
```
{
  session: { accessToken: string, refreshToken: string, expiresIn: number },
  user: {
    id, email, name, lane,
    roleCode,          // CLIENT → CLIENT; STAFF → STAFF_UNASSIGNED
    staffCode,         // null for CLIENT; string for STAFF
    emailVerifiedAt    // ISO-8601 | null
  }
}
```
**Errors:** `422` OTP_EXPIRED | VALIDATION_ERROR | EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED | LANE_REQUIRED; `409` LANE_MISMATCH; `429` AUTH_RATE_LIMITED.

Tests store accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn, userId on collection + environment.

**Story:** A user starts Google sign-in in the browser to authenticate without an email OTP.

GET /auth/google/start — public. **302** redirect to Supabase Google authorize (no JSON body).

originalRequest.description:
GET /auth/google/start — public. Starts Google OAuth via Supabase.

**Response type:** HTTP redirect (no JSON body)
**Success:** `302`/`303`/`307`/`308` with `Location` → Supabase `/auth/v1/authorize?provider=google&redirect_to=...`
**Errors:** `503` `OAUTH_CONFIGURATION` when Host/callback config is missing.

Open the resolved URL in a browser. After consent, copy `access_token` **and** `refresh_token` from the callback URL hash into `accessToken` / `refreshToken`, then run Complete Google Auth. Use Auth > Session > Refresh Session when the access token expires.

request.description:
**Story:** The app quietly renews an expired access token so the user stays signed in.

POST /auth/refresh — public. Rotates refresh token; always persist the new value.

**Auth:** none (refresh token in body)

**Request body (JSON):**
- `refreshToken` (required, string, min 1) — Current refresh token from last login/refresh.

**Success `200`:**
- `session.accessToken` (string) — New access token.
- `session.refreshToken` (string) — **New** refresh token (old one invalid).
- `session.expiresIn` (number) — Access TTL seconds. Example: `3600`.

**Errors:** `401` AUTHENTICATION_FAILED · `422` VALIDATION_ERROR

request.description:
**Story:** A staff member creates the gym’s organisation profile to begin onboarding.

POST /gym-orgs — create a gym. Actor must be `STAFF_UNASSIGNED` or `ADMIN`.

**Auth:** Bearer STAFF (`{{accessToken}}`)

**Request body (JSON):**
- `name` (required, string) — Gym name, 1–255 after trim. Example: `"North Star Fitness"`.
- `address` (optional, string or null) — Free-text address, max 2000; empty → null. Example: `"12 Lift St"` or `null`.
- `contactPhone` (optional, string or null) — Desk phone, max 50. Example: `"+15550001111"` or `null`.
- `contactEmail` (optional, string or null) — Valid email or null, max 255. Example: `"hello@example.com"` or `null`.
- `logoUrl` (optional, string or null) — Absolute URL or null, max 2048. Example: `"https://cdn.example/logo.png"` or `null`.
- `timezone` (optional, IANA string) — Defaults to `Asia/Kolkata` if omitted. Example: `"Asia/Kolkata"`.

**Success `201`:** `{ gymOrg }` with `id`, `name`, `address`, `contactPhone`, `contactEmail`, `logoUrl`, `timezone`, `ownerUserId`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` (no `isOwner` on create).

**Errors:** `403` GYM_ORG_CREATION_FORBIDDEN · `422` VALIDATION_ERROR

request.description:
**Story:** A gym admin invites another staff member (by staff code) to join as Admin or Trainer.

POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/staff-invites — invite STAFF by `staffCode` (in-app / QR, not email tokens). Max **3** admins including owner + pending ADMIN invites.

**Auth:** Bearer ADMIN  
**Path:** `gymOrgId`

**Request body (JSON):**
- `staffCode` (required, string) — Invitee’s staff code, 1–64 after trim. Example: `"STAFF-AB12"` (env `inviteeStaffCode`).
- `targetRole` (required, enum) — Role granted on accept. Values: `TRAINER`, `ADMIN`.
- `expiresAt` (optional, string ISO) — Defaults to **+14 days**. Example: `"2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z"`.

**Success `201`:** `{ staffInvite }`

**`staffInvite` fields:**
- `id` (uuid) — Invite id (stored as `staffInviteId`).
- `gymOrgId` (uuid) — Target gym.
- `invitedUserId` (uuid) — Resolved invitee.
- `targetRole` (enum) — Values: `TRAINER`, `ADMIN`.
- `status` (enum) — Values: `PENDING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REVOKED`, `EXPIRED`.
- `expiresAt` (string ISO or null) — Expiry.
- `createdBy` (uuid) — Admin creator.
- `acceptedAt` (string ISO or null) — Set on accept.
- `createdAt` / `updatedAt` (string, ISO) — Timestamps.

**Errors:** STAFF_INVITE_FORBIDDEN · INVALID_STAFF_INVITEE · STAFF_ALREADY_AFFILIATED · STAFF_INVITE_ADMIN_CAP · VALIDATION_ERROR

request.description:
**Story:** A gym admin records a walk-in inquiry so the team can follow up and convert them.

POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/leads — capture a lead. Status is always `NEW` on create (`followUpDate` starts null). Soft warn when another **open** lead shares the same phone — still `201`.

**Auth:** Bearer ADMIN at gym  
**Path:** `gymOrgId`

**Request body (JSON):**
- `name` (required, string) — Prospect name, 1–255 after trim. Example: `"Priya Walk-in"`.
- `phone` (required, string) — Contact phone, 1–32 after trim. Example: `"9876543210"`.
- `source` (optional, string or null) — Acquisition source, max 255. Example: `"Instagram"` or `null`.
- `interest` (optional, string or null) — Free-text what they want (trial, PT, etc.), max 2000. Example: `"Personal training trial"` or `null`.
- `notes` (optional, string or null) — Staff notes, max 5000. Example: `"Asked about evening slots"` or `null`.

**Success `201`:** `{ lead, warnings }`

**`lead` fields:**
- `id` (uuid) — Lead id (stored as `leadId`).
- `gymOrgId` (uuid) — Owning gym.
- `name` / `phone` (string) — Prospect.
- `source` (string or null) — Example: `"Instagram"`.
- `status` (enum) — Always `NEW` on create. Values: `NEW`, `CONTACTED`, `TRIAL`, `CONVERTED`, `LOST`.
- `interest` (string or null) — Free-text intent. Example: `"Personal training trial"`.
- `notes` (string or null)
- `followUpDate` (string or null) — `YYYY-MM-DD` or null (`null` on create).
- `createdBy` (uuid) — Admin.
- `createdAt` / `updatedAt` (string, ISO)

**`warnings[]` (soft):**
- `code` (enum) — Value: `DUPLICATE_OPEN_LEAD_PHONE`.
- `existingLeadIds` (uuid[]) — Other open leads with same phone.

**Errors:** `401` · `403` LEAD_FORBIDDEN · `422` VALIDATION_ERROR

Guide: gym-backend `docs/leads.md`.

- `id` (uuid) — Plan id.
- `gymOrgId` (uuid) — Owning gym.
- `name` (string) — Example: `"Monthly Base"`.

- `durationDays` (integer) — 1–3650.

request.description:
**Story:** A gym admin invites a client to join a plan so they can activate a membership.

POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/membership-invites — create a PENDING client membership invite.

**Auth:** Bearer ADMIN at gym  
**Path:** `gymOrgId`  
**Prereq:** active BASE plan in `planId` (Create BASE Plan)

**Request body (JSON):**
- `inviteeName` (required, string) — Display name, 1–255. Example: `"Alex Client"`.
- `invitedEmail` (required, string) — CLIENT match key (normalized lowercase). Example: `"alex.client@example.com"`.
- `inviteePhone` (optional, string) — Contact phone, 1–32. Example: `"+15551234567"`.
- `basePlanId` (required, uuid) — Active **BASE** plan. Example: `{{planId}}`.
- `basePaymentStatus` (required, enum) — Base line payment. Values: `paid`, `unpaid`, `partial`.
- `addonPlanId` (optional*, uuid) — Active `TRAINER_COACHING` **ADDON**; must pair with addon payment.
- `addonPaymentStatus` (optional*, enum) — Addon payment; must pair with addon plan. Values: `paid`, `unpaid`, `partial`.
- `expiresAt` (optional, string ISO) — Defaults **+14 days**. Example: `"2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z"`.

* Addon fields must be **both set or both omitted**. Cannot invite a STAFF email (`INVALID_MEMBERSHIP_INVITEE`).

**Success `201`:** `{ membershipInvite }`

**`membershipInvite` fields:**
- `id` (uuid) — Invite id → `membershipInviteId`.
- `gymOrgId` (uuid) — Issuing gym.
- `invitedEmail` (string) — Match email.
- `invitedUserId` (uuid or null) — Resolved CLIENT if provisioned.
- `inviteeName` / `inviteePhone` — Invitee.
- `basePlanId` (uuid) — BASE plan.
- `basePaymentStatus` (enum) — Values: `paid`, `unpaid`, `partial`.
- `addonPlanId` / `addonPaymentStatus` (uuid/null, enum/null) — Optional addon.
- `status` (enum) — Values: `PENDING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REVOKED`, `EXPIRED`.
- `expiresAt` (string ISO or null)
- `createdBy` (uuid) — Admin.
- `acceptedAt` / `acceptedMembershipId` — null until accept.
- `createdAt` / `updatedAt` (string, ISO)

**Errors:** `403` PLAN_FORBIDDEN · `409` CONFLICT · `422` INVALID_INVITE_PLAN / INVALID_MEMBERSHIP_INVITEE / VALIDATION_ERROR

Guide: gym-backend `docs/membership-invites.md`.

**`subscription` fields:**
- `id` (uuid) — Subscription line id → store as `subscriptionId`.
- `clientMembershipId` (uuid) — Owning membership.
- `gymOrgId` (uuid) — Tenancy.
- `planId` (uuid) — Snapshotted plan.
- `kind` (enum) — Values: `BASE`, `ADDON`.
- `capability` (enum or null) — `TRAINER_COACHING` for ADDON; `null` for BASE.
- `priceAmount` (number) — Snapshot price.
- `durationDays` (integer) — Snapshot duration.
- `startDate` (string `YYYY-MM-DD` or null) — Null = unstarted BASE.
- `endDate` (string `YYYY-MM-DD` or null) — Inclusive end.
- `startSource` (enum or null) — Values: `FIRST_ATTENDANCE`, `ADMIN_OVERRIDE`, `ADMIN_ATTACH`, or `null`.
- `paymentStatus` (enum) — Values: `paid`, `unpaid`, `partial`. Does **not** lock entitlements.
- `amountPaid` (number) — Derived/partial amount.
- `createdAt` / `updatedAt` (string, ISO)

**Errors:** `403` PLAN_FORBIDDEN · `404` no ACTIVE membership

Guide: gym-backend `docs/subscriptions.md`.

**Story:** A gym admin records whether a subscription is paid, unpaid, or partially paid.

- `paymentStatus` (required, enum) — Values: `paid`, `unpaid`, `partial`.
- `amountPaid` (conditional, number) — Required when `partial` (strictly between 0 and snapshotted `priceAmount`). Optional for `paid`/`unpaid` (server derives 0 or full price). Example: `250.5`.

**Errors:** `403` PLAN_FORBIDDEN · `404` NOT_FOUND · `422` INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT / VALIDATION_ERROR

**Story:** A gym admin manually starts an unstarted base plan when first attendance should not drive the start date.

**Path:** `gymOrgId`, `subscriptionId`

- `startDate` (required, string `YYYY-MM-DD`) — Inclusive start. Sets `endDate = startDate + durationDays - 1`, `startSource = ADMIN_OVERRIDE`. Example: `"2026-08-01"`.

Only **unstarted BASE** (`startDate` null). ADDON or already-started → `INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_START`.

**Success `200`:** `{ subscription }`  
**Errors:** `403` · `404` · `422` INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_START · `409` overlap (ADR-0004)

**Story:** A trainer (or admin acting as trainer) assigns a structured workout so the client knows what to do this week.

POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/clients/:clientUserId/workout-plans — archives the prior ACTIVE plan for that (client, gym). Lines are catalog ExerciseItem ids, never typed names. `WORKOUT_PLANS` grant is **not** required to author.

**Auth:** Bearer TRAINER (assigned) or ADMIN-as-Trainer at gym; client must have in-date `TRAINER_COACHING` addon
**Path:** `gymOrgId`, `clientUserId`

**Request body (JSON):**
- `title` (required, string) — 1–120 chars after trim. Example: `"Push Pull Legs"`.
- `notes` (optional, string or null) — Free-text, max 5000. Example: `null`.
- `days` (required, array, min 1) — Each day needs ≥1 exercise.
  - `dayLabel` (required, string) — 1–80 chars. Example: `"Push"`.
  - `exercises[]`:
    - `exerciseItemId` (required, uuid) — Live seed ExerciseItem.
    - `sets` (optional, integer) — 1–99. Example: `3`.
    - `reps` (optional, string) — Prescription, max 40. Example: `"8-12"`.
    - `notes` (optional, string or null) — Line notes.

**Success fields `workoutPlan`:**
- `id` / `clientUserId` / `trainerId` / `gymOrgId` (uuid)
- `title` / `notes` / `status` (`ACTIVE`)
- `writable` (boolean)
- `completionDate` (YYYY-MM-DD or null)
- `days[]` — `id`, `dayLabel`, `exercises[]` (`id`, `exerciseItemId`, `sets`, `reps`, `notes`)
- `clonedFromId` (uuid or null)
- `createdAt` / `updatedAt` (ISO)

**Success `201`:** `{ workoutPlan }`
**Errors:** `403` COACHING_FORBIDDEN · `404` NOT_FOUND · `409` COACHING_ADDON_REQUIRED · `422` INVALID_WORKOUT_PLAN / VALIDATION_ERROR
Guide: gym-backend `docs/coaching.md`.

request.description:
**Story:** A client opens the workout their trainer assigned and sees which exercises they already ticked today.

GET /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/my-workout-plan — client plan plus today’s `completed` flags (gym timezone).

**Auth:** Bearer CLIENT with ACTIVE membership at gym
**Path:** `gymOrgId`

`writable` is false after addon expiry (history still returned). `workoutPlan` may be `null`.

**Success `200`:** `{ workoutPlan }` — exercises include `completed` (boolean) and catalog `name` for gym-local today.
**Errors:** `403` COACHING_FORBIDDEN
Guide: gym-backend `docs/coaching.md`.

**Story:** A client ticks a prescribed exercise as done for today.

POST /gym-orgs/:gymOrgId/my-workout-plan/items/:itemId/complete — writes a PlanCompletion for gym-local today (not a set log).

**Auth:** Bearer CLIENT
**Path:**
- `gymOrgId` (uuid)
- `itemId` (uuid) — workout_plan_exercises.id. Example: `{{workoutPlanItemId}}`.

Second complete the same day → **409** `ALREADY_COMPLETED_WORKOUT_EXERCISE`. Expired addon → **409** `COACHING_ADDON_REQUIRED`.

**Success `204`:** empty body
**Errors:** `403` COACHING_FORBIDDEN · `404` NOT_FOUND · `409` ALREADY_COMPLETED_WORKOUT_EXERCISE / COACHING_ADDON_REQUIRED
Guide: gym-backend `docs/coaching.md`.

**Path:** `gymOrgId`, `itemId` (`{{workoutPlanItemId}}`)

**Errors:** `403` COACHING_FORBIDDEN · `404` NOT_FOUND · `409` COACHING_ADDON_REQUIRED
